value: Alam Badi Azmi, the member for Nizamabad (Assembly constituency 347) and the oldest member of the 18th Vidhan Sabha, died in July 2026. The Uttar Pradesh Vidhan Sabha made an obituary reference to him on 3 August 2026, and its NeVA portal now reports 399 sitting members against a House of 403.
source_name: India TV - Alam Badi Azmi, five-time SP MLA, dies

value: Pradyut Bordoloi, elected from Nagaon in 2024, resigned his Lok Sabha seat with effect from 20 March 2026; the Speaker announced acceptance on 24 March. He was elected to the Assam Legislative Assembly from Dispur in May 2026. The Lok Sabha Secretariat lists Nagaon among the vacant constituencies of the 18th Lok Sabha, and no by-election had been notified when this page was last checked.
source_name: Lok Sabha Secretariat - vacant constituencies of the 18th Lok Sabha (official)
